blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) have significantly promoted using text-to-image (T2I) models to generate images with specific affective intentions. However, the emotional effects conveyed by generated images frequently deviate from target expectations, and it remains unclear whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reliably interpret the emotion of AI-generated visual content. Existing affective benchmarks are predominantly built on natural images, while affective studies of generated images have largely focused on emotions expressed in portraits, lacking a unified benchmark for studying the emotions expressed and evoked by generated images. We therefore introduce EmoGenie, a benchmark of emotion for AI-generated images that evaluates capabilities in T2I generation and MLLM understanding across expressed and evoked emotions. It comprises 6,400 images generated by eight T2I models using 800 emotion-targeted prompts, annotated with question-answer (QA) pairs, termed EmoGenie-QA, and continuous human ratings, termed EmoGenie-Assess. EmoGenie-QA contains 90,000 closed-set questions in single-image and image-pair settings, as well as 1,057 open-ended questions for emotion description. EmoGenie-Assess benchmarks continuous affective and aesthetic prediction using 13,175 mean opinion scores (MOSs) aggregated from human ratings in terms of valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality. We further develop EmoProbe, which combines emotion question answering with response-aligned, dimension-specific regression heads for continuous score prediction. Experimental results show that EmoProbe achieves superior results on emotion-related QA tasks, while its affective and aesthetic predictions correlate better with human ratings, demonstrating its state-of-the-art capabilities of unified coarse-to-fine affective understanding for AI-generated images.
blocks.zh: 人工智能生成内容(AIGC)的快速进步大大地促进了使用文本到图像(T2I)模型生成具有特定情感意图的图像. 然而,生成的图像所传达的情感效应往往偏离了目标预期,目前仍不清楚多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)是否能够可靠地诠释AI生成的视觉内容的情感. 现有的情感基准主要建立在自然图像上,而对所生成图像的情感研究则主要侧重于以肖像形式表达的情绪,缺乏研究所生成图像所表达和所激发的情绪的统一基准. 因此,我们引入了EmoGenie,这是AI生成的图像的情感基准,用于评价T2I生成中的能力以及MLLM在表达和激发的情感中的理解. 它由8个T2I模型利用800个情感定向提示生成的6400个图像组成,并附加了"问答"(QA)对称,称为"EmoGenie-QA",并连续的人类收视率称为"EmoGenie-Assess". EmoGenie-QA包含9万个在单相和图像pair设置中的闭塞问题,以及1,057个供情感描述的开放式问题. EmoGenie-Assess使用从人类的评分中汇总的13,175个平均评分(MOS),从价值、振奋、支配地位和审美质量等方面,对持续影响和审美预测进行了基准。 我们进一步发展了"EmoProbe",它结合了情绪问题回答和响应相适应,维度特定的回归头来进行连续分数预测. 实验结果表明,EmoProbe在情感相关QA任务上取得了优异的成绩,而它的感官和审美预测则与人类的评级有更好的关联,显示了其对AI生成的图像的统一粗对细的感官理解的先进能力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) have substantially improved the fidelity, diversity, and controllability of text-to-image (T2I) generation ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . T2I models can generate high-quality images spanning diverse subjects, scenes, and visual styles from natural-language prompts. The expanding application of these models in visual content creation has increased demand for images that embody specific affective intentions. However, the affect conveyed by a generated image does not always align with the intended emotion, despite semantic fidelity to the prompt. Such discrepancies compromise the intended visual message and undermine the reliability of emotion-conditioned image generation. These concerns extend from emotion generation to emotion understanding. In this context, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a means of interpreting the affective content of generated images, yet their consistency with human perception remains unclear. Accordingly, we consider two fundamental questions:
blocks.zh: 人工智能生成内容(AIGC)的近期进步,极大地改善了文本到图像(T2I)生成的忠实性,多样性和可控性(Chen等,2024;Esser等,2024;Wu等,2025.). T2I模型可以从自然语言的提示中生成跨越不同主题,场景和视觉风格的高质量图像. 这些模型在视觉内容创作中的应用不断扩大,增加了对体现具体情感意图的图像的需求. 然而,一个生成的图像所传达的影响并不总是与预期的情感一致,尽管语义上忠于即时. 这种差异会损害预期的视觉信息,并会损害情感条件图像生成的可靠性. 这些担忧从情感一代到情感理解. 在这方面,多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)为解释所生成图像的活性内容提供了一种手段,然而它们与人类认知的一致性仍然不明确. 因此,我们考虑两个基本问题:

blocks.en: Can T2I models generate images that align with the intended emotion?
blocks.zh: 能够 T2 我模型生成的图像符合预期的情感?

blocks.en: Can MLLMs interpret the affective content of generated images consistently with human perception?
blocks.zh: MLLMS能否将生成的图像的活性内容与人类的认知一致地解释?

blocks.en: Together, these questions motivate a unified benchmark that assesses emotion in AI-generated images and supports the evaluation of MLLM emotion understanding.
blocks.zh: 这些问题共同激励了一个统一的基准,在AI生成的图像中评估情感,并支持对MLLM情感理解的评价.

blocks.en: The affective content of an image can be understood from two distinct perspectives. Expressed emotion denotes the affect conveyed by a depicted individual, while evoked emotion denotes the viewer’s affective response to the image. Given their distinct perceptual bases, the two perspectives may yield different judgments for the same image and impose different requirements on emotion generation. Their joint analysis therefore provides a more comprehensive account of affective content. Existing affective datasets predominantly comprise natural images annotated for facial expressions, artistic content, or scene-induced responses ( Mikels et al., 2005 ; Machajdik & Hanbury, 2010 ; Peng et al., 2015 ) , whereas research on generated images has focused mainly on expressed emotion in synthetic portraits ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Schuhmann et al., 2026 ) . Recent MLLM benchmarks incorporate additional task formats for emotion assessment, including ranking, emotion reasoning, dimensional assessment, and open-ended description ( Gao et al., 2025 ; She et al., 2026 ) . However, a systematic benchmark encompassing both perspectives in AI-generated images remains unavailable. Consequently, the effectiveness of T2I generation and MLLM understanding across expressed and evoked emotions remains insufficiently characterized.
blocks.zh: 图像的活性内容可以从两个不同的角度来理解. 表达的情感表示一个被描绘的个人所传达的影响,而激发的情感则表示观众对图像的情感反应. 鉴于这两个观点具有不同的认知基础,它们可能会对同一形象产生不同的判断,并对情感生成施加不同的要求. 因此,它们的联合分析更全面地说明了情感内容。 现有的有震撼性的数据集主要包括:为面部表情、艺术内容或场景引起的反应附加说明的自然图像(Mikels等人,2005年;Machajdik & Hanbury, 2010; Peng等,2015),而所生成图像的研究主要集中于合成肖像中的表达出情感(周等,2026;许克曼等,2026). 近期的MLLM基准包含了情感评估的额外任务格式,包括排名,情感推理,维度评估,以及开放式描述(Gao等,2025;She等,2026). 然而,AI生成的图像中包含两种观点的系统基准仍然没有。 因此,T2I生成和MLLM在表达和激起的情绪中的理解的有效性仍然不够突出。

blocks.en: To this end, we construct EmoGenie , a benchmark for jointly evaluating emotion generation and understanding in AI-generated images (AIGIs) from expressed and evoked perspectives. Using 800 800 prompts spanning both perspectives, we generate 6,400 6{,}400 images with eight T2I models and collect 384 384 K human annotations across six applicable dimensions: emotion category, expression intensity, valence, arousal, dominance (VAD), and aesthetic quality. From these annotations, we derive two subsets: EmoGenie-QA , comprising 90 90 K closed-set questions for single-image and image-pair perception and 1,057 1{,}057 open-ended questions for emotion description; and EmoGenie-Assess , comprising over 13 13 K continuous affective and aesthetic scores. Together, the subsets support perception, description, and assessment within a unified evaluation framework, enabling joint evaluation of T2I emotion alignment and human-aligned MLLM understanding.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们构建了“EmoGenie ” (EmoGenie),这是从表达和被激发的角度,在AI生成的图像中共同评价情感产生和理解的基准。 使用800个横跨两个视角的提示, 我们生成6400 6{,}400个图像, 并有8个T2I模型, 从这些说明中,我们得出了两个子集:EmoGenie-QA,包含90个90K个用于单相和图像-pair感知的闭集问题和1,057 1{,}057个用于情感描述的开放式问题;和EmoGenie-Assess,包含13个以上的连续有感和审美分数. 这些子集共同支持在统一评价框架内的感知、描述和评估,从而能够联合评价T2I情感相接和人与人相通的MLLM。

blocks.en: Building on EmoGenie, we further develop EmoProbe through a two-stage training procedure that integrates emotion question answering with continuous score prediction. Specifically, the first stage performs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on EmoGenie-QA to equip the model with coarse-grained emotion perception capabilities. The second stage uses dimension-specific regression heads to align response-conditioned representations with the perceptual assessments in EmoGenie-Assess, enabling VAD and aesthetic score prediction. This formulation unifies discrete emotion understanding and continuous score prediction within a single multimodal model. Experiments validate the effectiveness of EmoProbe and reveal substantial performance variation across current T2I models and MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 在EmoGenie的基础上,我们通过一个将情绪问题回答与连续分数预测相结合的两阶段训练程序来进一步发展EmoProbe. 具体而言,第一阶段在EmoGenie-QA上进行有监督的微调(SFT),使模型具有粗糙的情感感知能力. 第二阶段使用针对维度的回归头来使有响应条件的表示与EmoGenie-Assess的知觉评估相配合,使VAD和美学分数预测成为可能. 这种配方统一了单一多式模型内离散的情感理解和连续分数预测. 实验验证了EmoProbe的功效,并揭示出目前T2I模型和MLLMs之间的实质性性能差异.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce EmoGenie , a large-scale benchmark for emotion analysis in AIGIs, comprising 6,400 6{,}400 images and over 91 91 K question-answer pairs. By systematically covering both expressed and evoked perspectives, EmoGenie supports emotion perception, description, and assessment within a unified dataset. • We benchmark representative T2I models and MLLMs on EmoGenie, establishing a unified evaluation of emotion generation and understanding. The results reveal marked variation across affective perspectives, emotion categories, and evaluation tasks. • We develop EmoProbe , a multimodal emotion model trained in two stages to integrate emotion question answering with response-aligned regression. EmoProbe achieves state-of-the-art performance on both coarse-grained emotion perception and fine-grained affective assessment of AIGIs.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们介绍EmoGenie,这是AIGIs的大型情感分析基准,由6400 6{,}400个图像和超过91个91K个问答对组成. EmoGenie通过系统地涵盖所表达和所引出的观点,支持在一个统一的数据集内进行情感感知、描述和评估。 我们把代表性的T2I模型和MLLMs作为EmoGenie的基准,建立对情感产生和理解的统一评价. 结果显示,情感视角、情感类别和评价工作之间存在显著差异。 我们开发了EmoProbe, 一个多模式的情感模型, 训练了两个阶段, EmoProbe在粗糙的情感感知和精细的AIGIs影响评价上都实现了最先进的性能.

By systematically covering both expressed and evoked perspectives, EmoGenie supports emotion perception, description, and assessment within a unified dataset.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Emotion Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉情感数据集

blocks.en: Traditionally, visual emotion analysis has focused on natural images. Early datasets like ArtPhoto, Abstract-8 ( Machajdik & Hanbury, 2010 ) , and Emotion6 ( Peng et al., 2015 ) capture discrete emotions or affective distributions, while EEmo-Bench ( Gao et al., 2025 ) expands the scope with diverse tasks such as emotion ranking and dimensional assessment. Furthermore, recent benchmarks like AICA-Bench ( She et al., 2026 ) and E 3 mo-Bench ( Gao et al., 2026a ) advance the field by distinguishing between expressed emotions and evoked emotions. However, these comprehensive evaluation paradigms remain largely absent for AIGIs. Current AIGI benchmarks rarely combine diverse tasks with joint expressed-evoked modeling, resulting in an incomplete affective characterization.
blocks.zh: 传统上,视觉情感分析一直以自然影像为主. 早期数据集有"ArtPhoto","摘要-8"(Machajdik & Hanbury,2010年)和"情感6"(Peng等,2015年)等,能捕捉到离散的情感或情感分布;而"EEmo-Bench"(Gao等,2025年)则以情感排名和维度评估等多种任务来扩展范围. 此外,最近的一些基准,如AICA-Bench(她等人,2026年)和E 3 mo-Bench(Gao等人,2026年a年),通过区分表达的情绪和激起的情绪,推动了该领域的发展。 然而,对于AIGI来说,这些综合评价范式仍然基本不存在. AIGI目前的基准很少将各种任务与联合表达式模型结合起来,导致不完全的有影响特征。

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarks for AIGIs
blocks.zh: 2.2 AIGIs的基准

blocks.en: Research on affective image generation examines whether synthesized or edited images convey intended emotions. EmoGen ( Yang et al., 2024 ) conditions generation on discrete emotion categories, whereas EmotiCrafter ( Dang et al., 2025 ) uses continuous valence–arousal coordinates. EmoEdit ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Make Me Happier ( Lin et al., 2025 ) instead modify existing images to elicit a target affect. MEMO-Bench ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) evaluates emotion generation and interpretation in synthetic portraits through expression, intensity, and visual quality, while EmoNet-Face ( Schuhmann et al., 2026 ) provides an expert taxonomy of facial emotions in generated images. Existing evaluations, however, focus largely on generation controllability, affective editing, or facial expression, leaving the joint evaluation of expressed and evoked emotion in AIGIs underexplored.
blocks.zh: 关于感人图像生成的研究考察了被合成或被编辑的图像是否传达出预期的情感. EmoGen(Yang等,2024年)以离散的情感类别为生成条件,而EmotiCrafter(Dang等,2025年)则使用连续活性-活性坐标. EmoEdit(Yang等人,2025年)和Make Me Happier(Lin等人,2025年)修改了现有的图像,以引出目标影响. MEMO-Bench(周克等,2026年)通过表达,强度,和视觉质量来评价合成肖像中的情感产生和诠释,而EmoNet-Face(Shuhmann等,2026年)则在生成的图像中提供了面部情感的专家分类. 然而,现有的评价主要侧重于生成可控性、情感编辑或面部表情,使AIGI的表达和激发情绪的联合评价未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: 2.3 Emotion-Oriented MLLMs
blocks.zh: 2.3 以情感为导向的MLLMs

blocks.en: Emotion-oriented MLLMs broaden visual emotion analysis beyond recognition by supporting reasoning, explanation, comparison, and continuous assessment. EmoVIT ( Xie et al., 2024 ) and AffectGPT ( Lian et al., 2025 ) are trained with visual instructions designed for emotion understanding, whereas Emotion-Qwen ( Huang et al., 2025 ) integrates generalist and emotion-specialized experts. EmoCaliber ( Wu et al., 2026 ) strengthens the reliability of affective judgments through confidence verbalization and calibration. EEmo-Logic ( Gao et al., 2026b ) adopts multi-stage optimization to progressively learn emotion perception, comparison, description, and continuous affect prediction. Most of these models, however, are developed and evaluated on natural images or address only one affective perspective. Their alignment with human judgments of expressed and evoked emotion in AIGIs therefore remains unclear.
blocks.zh: 以情感为取向的MLLMs通过支持推理,解释,比较和连续评估,将视觉情感分析拓宽至识别之外. EmoVIT(Xie等,2024年)和AffectGPT(Lian等,2025年)接受为情感理解而设计的视觉指令培训,而"情感-昆"(Huang等,2025年)则融合了通论和情感-特化专家. EmoCaliber(Wu等,2026年)通过信心口语和校正来增强亲切判断的可靠性. EEmo-Logic(Gao等,2026b.)采用多相优化,以逐步学习情感感知,比较,描述,并持续地影响预测. 然而,这些模型大多是在自然图像上开发和评价的,或者只涉及一种情感视角。 因此,它们与人类对AIGI中表达和激起的情感的判断一致,仍然不清楚。

blocks.en: 3 EmoGenie Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3 EmoGenie基准建设

blocks.en: EmoGenie has two subsets: 1) EmoGenie-QA supports emotion perception and evidence-grounded description, whereas 2) EmoGenie-Assess provides continuous affective and aesthetic scores. Fig. 1 summarizes image generation, annotation, and subset construction.
blocks.zh: EmoGenie有两个子集: 1)EmoGenie-QA支持情感感知和有证据依据的描述,而2)EmoGenie-Assess则提供连续的感知和美学分数. 图1概述了图像生成、注释和子集构建。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: Expressed and evoked emotion rely on different perceptual cues. We therefore construct a separate prompt pool for each perspective. The expressed emotion pool follows Ekman’s six basic emotions and neutral ( Ekman & Friesen, 1971 ) : anger (ANG), disgust (DIS), fear (FEA), happiness (HAP), sadness (SAD), surprise (SUR), and neutral (NEU). To represent expressions of varying intensity, we vary affective terms together with the corresponding facial and bodily actions. For evoked emotion, we adopt the discrete taxonomy introduced by Mikels et al. (2005) . The positive categories are amusement (AMU), awe (AWE), contentment (CON), and excitement (EXC), and the negative categories are anger, disgust, fear, and sadness. Prompts describe emotionally salient scenes and contextual cues intended to elicit each response. Together, the two pools contain 800 800 prompts, with 400 400 for each perspective.
blocks.zh: 表达和激起的情感依赖于不同的感官提示. 因此,我们为每一种观点分别建立一个快速池。 表达的情感池跟随了艾克曼的6个基本情感和中性(Ekman & Friesen, 1971年):愤怒(ANG),厌恶(DIS),恐惧(FEA),幸福(HAP),悲伤(SAD),惊喜(SUR)和中性(NEU). 为了表示不同强度的表达,我们用不同的动词来表示相应的面部和身体动作. 我们采用Mikels等人(2005年)提出的离散分类法, 积极的分类是娱乐(AMU)、敬畏(AWE)、满足(CON)和兴奋(EXC),消极分类是愤怒、厌恶、恐惧和悲伤。 提示描述情感显著的场景和背景提示,旨在引起每次回应. 两个集合共包含800800个活字,每个视角有400400个活字.

blocks.en: We apply all 800 800 prompts to eight representative T2I models spanning open- and closed-source systems (Tab. 2 ). The resulting collection comprises 6,400 6{,}400 AIGIs, evenly distributed across the expressed and evoked perspectives, and supports the systematic evaluation of emotion understanding in MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们把所有800个提示器应用到8个具有代表性的T2I模型中,这些模型跨越了开源和闭源系统(第2段)。 由此产生的汇编包括6 400个6{,}400个AIGI,均匀地分布在表达和被唤起的视角中,并支持对MLLMs中情感理解的系统评价.

blocks.en: 3.2 Subjective Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 主观说明

blocks.en:
Annotation is conducted in two rounds. In the first round, each of the 6,400 6{,}400 images receives 15 15 independent annotations. The annotation protocol encompasses three aspects:
1) Emotion category identifies either the emotion conveyed by the visible expression or the emotion evoked in the viewer, according to the target affective perspective.
2) Graded affective attributes comprise expression intensity for expressed-emotion images and VAD for evoked-emotion images. Expression intensity captures the strength of observable facial and bodily cues, whereas VAD characterizes the pleasantness, activation, and perceived control associated with the viewer’s affective response using the 9 9 -point Self-Assessment Manikin scale ( Bradley & Lang, 1994 ) .
3) Aesthetic quality is rated on a 1 1 – 5 5 scale according to composition, color, illumination, clarity, realism, and overall visual impact ( Series, 2012 ) .

blocks.en: To assess both absolute and relative judgments, we construct single-image and image-pair questions from the aggregated annotations across all applicable dimensions. Single-image questions evaluate whether a model can recognize the affective and aesthetic attributes of an individual image. Image-pair questions instead probe whether it can distinguish variations in these attributes across images. The perception task contains 90 90 K questions, comprising 40 40 K single-image and 50 50 K image-pair questions.

blocks.en: To extend evaluation beyond categorical selection, we construct single-image and image-pair questions from the evidence-grounded annotations collected in the second round. blocks.zh: 4.1 示范建筑

blocks.en: EmoProbe extends a pretrained MLLM with dimension-specific regression heads, supporting emotion perception, evidence-grounded description, and continuous assessment within a unified model. Given a visual input and task instruction, the multimodal backbone produces contextual representations for textual generation, while response-aligned representations are mapped to continuous affective and aesthetic scores.
blocks.zh: EmoProbe扩展了预先训练的MLLM,带有维度特定回归头,支持情感感知,有证据依据的描述,以及统一模型内的连续评估. 鉴于视觉输入和任务指示,多式主干线为文字生成制作背景表述,而反应相匹配的表述则被绘制成连续的情感和美学分数.

blocks.en: 4.2 Two-Stage Training
blocks.zh: 4.2 两阶段培训

blocks.en: EmoProbe follows a coarse-to-fine training strategy. Stage 1 1 establishes coarse-grained perception through instruction tuning on EmoGenie-QA, and Stage 2 2 extends this capability to fine-grained score regression using EmoGenie-Assess.
blocks.zh: EmoProbe遵循粗放至精良的训练策略. 第1阶段 第1阶段通过EmoGenie-QA的指令调谐来建立粗糙的受克感知,第2阶段使用EmoGenie-Assess将这种能力扩展至精细受克分回归.

blocks.en: We instruction-tune EmoProbe on the perception portion of EmoGenie-QA. Conditioned on either a single image or an image pair together with a task instruction, the model predicts the corresponding categorical response. The autoregressive cross-entropy loss over the target response tokens jointly optimizes the multimodal projector and the low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters introduced into the vision encoder and language model. This optimization adapts the multimodal representations and generated responses to both single-image judgments and image-pair comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们指导EmoProbe 关于EmoGenie-QA的感知部分。 该模型在单个图像或一对图像上附加任务指令,预测相应的绝对响应. 相对于目标响应符的自旋相向跨入损失,联合优化了多式投影仪和引入到视觉编码器和语言模型中的低等适应(LORA)参数. 这种优化适应了多模式表述,并产生了对单一图像判断和图像与图像对比的反应。

blocks.en:
We subsequently train EmoProbe on EmoGenie-Assess for fine-grained continuous assessment. Given an image and a dimension-specific instruction, the model generates a structured response containing the normalized score. The response-aligned representation defined in Section 4.1 is then mapped by the corresponding regression head to a continuous prediction. The structured response is supervised autoregressively, and the predicted score is regressed against the associated human rating. Throughout this stage, the multimodal projector remains frozen, while the vision and language LoRA parameters and the four regression heads are jointly optimized.

blocks.en: Following Sec. 4.2 , EmoProbe is trained on two NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs with 48 48 GB of memory each. Both stages apply LoRA to the linear layers of the vision encoder and language model ( r = 64 r=64 , α = 128 \alpha=128 , dropout = 0.05 =0.05 ). Stage 2 2 freezes the projector and trains the LoRA parameters and four regression heads for one epoch with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} .

blocks.en: For emotion generation, we evaluate the eight T2I models using the complete EmoGenie image set. For emotion understanding, we compare EmoProbe with 14 14 general-purpose open-source, proprietary, and emotion-oriented MLLMs on EmoGenie-QA and EmoGenie-Assess. The perception and assessment subsets are partitioned into image-disjoint training and test sets at a 4 : 1 4{:}1 ratio, whereas the description subset is reserved entirely for evaluation.

blocks.en: T2I models are evaluated by soft alignment accuracy and mean aesthetic quality. For MLLMs, perception is evaluated by exact-match accuracy, and assessment is evaluated using the Spearman (SRCC) and Pearson (PLCC) correlations. With reference to EEmo-Logic ( Gao et al., 2026b ) , description is evaluated along four dimensions: correctness , completeness , relevance , and conciseness . DeepSeek-v4-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026 ) scores the first three, while conciseness is length-based. The four 0 0 – 2 2 scores are averaged and rescaled to 0 0 – 100 100 . For open-source MLLMs that cannot directly produce calibrated continuous scores, we adopt the Q-BENCH ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) logit-softmax protocol. Detailed evaluation procedures are provided in the appendix.

blocks.en: Expressed-emotion alignment. For expressed emotion, GPT-Image-2 attains the highest average alignment, followed by Qwen-Image. Seven of the eight models perform better from the expressed perspective than from the evoked perspective, although the magnitude of this advantage differs considerably across models. The category-level results reveal a pronounced disparity in generation difficulty. Happiness and surprise are reproduced consistently across most models, while fear and disgust show much wider variation. Several stronger models also achieve high alignment for neutral and sadness. The reliable generation of sadness alongside unstable fear and disgust indicates that emotional polarity alone is insufficient to explain the observed difficulty; the distinctiveness of facial and bodily configurations appears to play an important role.
blocks.zh: 表达-情感相接. 对于表达的情感,GPT-Image-2达到了最高的平均对齐,其次是Quen-Image. 8个模型中有7个从表达的角度看表现优于从被引用的角度看表现好,尽管不同模型中这种优势的程度差别很大。 类别层面的结果表明,在生成困难方面存在明显的差异。 快乐和惊喜在大多数模式中不断被重现,而恐惧和厌恶则显示出更大的差异。 一些更强大的模式也实现了中性和悲哀的高度一致。 与不稳定的恐惧和恶心相伴而生的可信赖的一代悲哀表明,仅凭情感的极性不足以解释所观察到的困难;面部和身体相貌的特异性似乎起重要作用.

blocks.en: Evoked-emotion alignment. Evoked-emotion generation presents a different pattern. Qwen-Image obtains the highest average alignment, while GPT-Image-2 ranks second despite its clear advantage for expressed emotion. Contentment is generated reliably by all models, and excitement also remains comparatively stable. Anger is consistently the most difficult category; amusement and sadness exhibit greater model-dependent variation. Evoked emotion is shaped by the joint contribution of scene content, composition, lighting, and atmosphere. Variation across these categories consequently reflects the greater difficulty of controlling the emotion elicited through scene-level visual cues. The change in model ranking further indicates that strong expressed-emotion generation does not consistently transfer to the evoked perspective.
blocks.zh: Evoked-Emotion对齐. Evoked-Emotion一代呈现出不同的模式. Quen-Image获得最高的平均比分,而GPT-Image-2尽管对表达出情感有着明显的优势,却排名第二. 所有模型都可靠地生成了内容,兴奋度也保持了相对稳定. 愤怒始终是最困难的类别;娱乐和悲伤表现出更大的依赖模型的变化。 场景内容、组成、照明和气氛共同贡献,塑造了情感。 因此,这些类别的差异反映了控制场景视觉提示所引发的情绪的更大困难。 模型排名的变化还表明,强烈的表达式情绪生成不能始终如一地向被激发的视角转移。

blocks.en: Aesthetic quality. Aesthetic ratings reveal a separate source of variation. GPT-Image-2 receives the highest ratings from both perspectives, while Qwen-Image and Seedream-5.0 also produce visually strong results. Seven models receive higher ratings for evoked-emotion images than for expressed-emotion images, with GPT-Image-2 as the exception. This asymmetry is consistent with the additional structural constraints involved in rendering coherent faces, bodies, and emotion-specific details. Together with the perspective-specific alignment patterns, these results point to distinct priorities for further improvement: finer structural control over faces and bodies for expressed emotion, and more reliable affective composition of complete scenes for evoked emotion.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce EmoGenie , a benchmark for evaluating emotion generation and understanding in AIGIs from expressed- and evoked-emotion perspectives. Building on this benchmark, we develop EmoProbe , an emotion-oriented MLLM that integrates coarse-grained perception and fine-grained continuous assessment through two-stage training. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EmoProbe and reveal substantial variation in the emotion-generation capabilities of current T2I models across affective perspectives and emotion categories, providing valuable insights into key challenges and directions for future affect-aware image generation and understanding.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了EmoGenie,这是从表达和被激发的情绪角度评价AIGI的情感产生和理解的基准。 在这个基准的基础上,我们开发了EmoProbe,一种以情感为导向的MLLM,通过两阶段培训将粗糙的感知和精细的连续评估结合起来. 实验展示了"EmoProbe"的功效并揭示出当前T2I模型在情感生成能力上的巨大差异,跨越了情感视角和情感类别,为未来影响意识图像生成和理解的关键挑战和方向提供了宝贵的见解.

blocks.en: Ethics statement

blocks.en: This study focuses on emotion generation by T2I models and emotion understanding by MLLMs, with human participants involved only in the annotation of AI-generated images. Annotators assessed expressed and evoked emotions, expression intensity, VAD, aesthetic quality, and evidence-grounded emotion descriptions. Before data collection, all annotators were informed of the annotation procedure and the intended use of the resulting data; each participant provided informed consent and received monetary compensation. Annotation records were processed without directly identifying personal information. The construction and intended research use of EmoGenie follow the principles of privacy protection, responsible data use, and transparency set out in the ICLR Code of Ethics.

blocks.en: A.1 Emotion Taxonomies and Prompt Design
blocks.zh: A.1 情感分类和即时设计

blocks.en: EmoGenie treats expressed emotion and evoked emotion as two distinct objectives during prompt construction because they depend on different sources of visual evidence. Expressed emotion concerns the affect displayed by a depicted person and is primarily conveyed through facial configuration, gaze, posture, and bodily action. Evoked emotion concerns the affect elicited in a viewer and may arise from objects, events, spatial composition, illumination, colour, atmosphere, or their interaction. Accordingly, we construct an independent prompt pool for each perspective.
blocks.zh: EmoGenie将表达的情感和激发的情感视为快速构造过程中的两个不同的目标,因为它们依赖于不同的视觉证据来源. 表达的情感关注被描绘的人所表现出来的影响,主要通过面部造型,凝视,姿势和身体动作来传达. Evoked情感涉及在取景器中被引出的影响,可能出自物体,事件,空间组成,发光,颜色,大气,或其相互作用. 因此,我们为每个方面建立一个独立的快速集合。

blocks.en: Across both pools, prompt design follows three principles. First, the intended emotion is stated explicitly to establish a controlled generation objective. Second, each prompt contains concrete visual content that can realize this objective, avoiding prompts that consist only of an abstract emotion word. Third, prompts remain concise enough to leave substantial freedom in composition and rendering. The resulting prompts specify a common affective target without prescribing an identical scene. We supply the same semantic prompts to every T2I model so that their outputs can be compared under matched generation conditions.
blocks.zh: 在两个集合中,即时设计遵循了三项原则。 首先,要明确表达意向情绪,以确立一个受控制的生成目标。 第二,每个提示包含具体的视觉内容,可以实现这个目标,避免只由抽象情感词组成的提示. 第三,提示仍然简明扼要,足以在组成和表述方面留下相当的自由。 生成的提示指定了一个共同的感人目标,而不指定一个相同的场景. 我们向每个T2I模型提供相同的语义提示,以便在相匹配的生成条件下比较它们的输出.

blocks.en: The expressed-emotion pool follows Ekman’s six basic emotions and adds a neutral category ( Ekman & Friesen, 1971 ) , yielding anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and neutral. Each prompt combines five elements: an age group, a gender term, a social or occupational identity, the intended expression, and observable evidence supporting that expression. The evidence is written in visual terms so that intensity is reflected in observable facial and bodily actions.
blocks.zh: 表达情感池遵循了艾克曼的六大基本情感,并增加了中性类别(艾克曼&弗里森,1971年),产生出愤怒,厌恶,恐惧,幸福,悲伤,出人意料,中立. 每个提示包含五个要素:一个年龄组、一个性别术语、一个社会或职业身份、意图表达以及支持这一表达的可观察证据。 证据是用视觉写成的,这样强度就体现在可观察到的面部和身体动作上.

blocks.en: Mild anger: “a teenage woman passenger with an annoyed expression, jaw slightly tightened.” Intense anger: “a young woman artist with an enraged expression, eyes glaring, fists clenched.”
blocks.zh: 愤怒地说 : “ 一名生气的女乘客, 强烈的愤怒:“一位年轻女性艺术家,充满愤怒的表情,目光明亮,拳头紧握。 “

blocks.en: These examples vary the tension of the face, direction of gaze, and involvement of the body while preserving the same emotion category.
blocks.zh: 这些例子改变了相貌的张力,视线的方向,以及身体的参与,同时保留了相同的情感类别.

blocks.en: The prompt pool spans mild, moderate, and intense expressions. Intensity is represented by coordinated changes in descriptive vocabulary and visible behaviour, including the tension of the mouth or jaw, eye opening and gaze, eyebrow position, tears, hand gestures, and posture. Neutral prompts retain the same structured format but use cues such as relaxed features, a steady gaze, or a calm and still posture. This design makes intensity a controlled prompt attribute while avoiding a single fixed action template for each emotion.
blocks.zh: 快速池的表达方式温和、中和和强烈。 强度表现在描述性词汇和明显行为的协调变化上,包括口腔或下巴的张力,眼睛开口和凝视,眉毛位置,眼泪,手势,和姿势等. 中立提示保留相同的结构格式,但使用提示,如放松的特征,平稳的视线,或冷静而平稳的姿态等. 这种设计使得强度成为可控的即时属性,同时避免为每个情感提供一个单一的固定动作模板.

blocks.en: The 400 400 expressed-emotion prompts comprise 53 53 anger, 60 60 disgust, 60 60 fear, 47 47 happiness, 44 44 neutral, 66 66 sadness, and 70 70 surprise instances. They include 156 156 mild, 110 110 moderate, and 134 134 intense expressions. Demographic and contextual attributes are also varied: the pool contains 193 193 prompts referring to women and 207 207 referring to men, with 87 87 teenage, 110 110 young, 106 106 middle-aged, and 97 97 elderly subjects. Fourteen identities, including passenger, artist, researcher, teacher, athlete, musician, and office worker, diversify the depicted context. These attributes are distributed across emotion and intensity categories instead of being assigned to a single fixed combination.
blocks.zh: 400 400个表达情感的促发词包括:53个愤怒、60个厌恶、60个恐惧、47个幸福、44个中立、66个悲伤和70个意外事件。 其中包括156个轻度表达,110个轻度表达,134个重度表达. 人口特征和背景属性也各不相同:池中包含193,193个指女性的提示和207个指男性的提示,其中87,87个青少年、110,110个青少年、106个中年和97,97个老年科目。 14个身份,包括乘客、艺术家、研究员、教师、运动员、音乐家和办公室工作人员,使描绘的背景多样化。 这些属性分布在情感和强度类别之间,而不是被分配到单一的固定组合.

blocks.en: The evoked-emotion pool adopts the eight-category taxonomy of Mikels et al. ( Mikels et al., 2005 ) : amusement, awe, contentment, excitement, anger, disgust, fear, and sadness. It follows a scene-centred design in which semantic content and visual organization jointly establish the intended viewer response. The prompts cover interpersonal events, natural environments, everyday objects, signs of damage or neglect, potentially threatening situations, and atmospheric scenes. Human figures are included when they contribute to the depicted event. Many prompts rely on objects, environments, lighting, or composition as their primary affective evidence.
blocks.zh: 被引用的情绪池采用Mikels等人的八类分类法。 (Mikels等,2005年):娱乐,敬畏,满足,兴奋,愤怒,厌恶,恐惧和悲伤. 它遵循以场景为中心的设计,其中语义内容和视觉组织共同建立预期的取景者反应. 这些诱因包括人际事件、自然环境、日常物品、损坏或被忽略的迹象、潜在的威胁情况以及大气场景。 人类人物在为所描绘的事件出力时也包括在内. 许多提示依靠物体、环境、照明或构成作为其主要的活性证据。

blocks.en: Prompts within each category cover several elicitation routes. Awe is represented through scale and visual vastness, and contentment through warmth and stillness.
blocks.zh: 每个类别内的提示包括若干诱导路线。 Awe通过规模和视觉的宽度来代表,通过温暖和静态来表示满足.

blocks.en: Awe: “a massive glacier with deep blue crevasses under a clear sky.” Contentment: “a warm blanket draped over a chair beside a glowing fireplace.”
blocks.zh: Awe:“一片巨大的冰川, 内容:“一张温暖的毯子被一个发光的壁炉旁边的椅子上画出。 “

blocks.en: Anger prompts depict violations, obstruction, or unfair conduct. Fear prompts introduce threat, uncertainty, darkness, height, or precarious spatial relations.
blocks.zh: 愤怒促使人们描述侵权行为、阻挠或不公平行为。 恐惧引发了威胁、不确定性、黑暗、高度或不稳定的空间关系。

blocks.en: Anger: “a freshly painted wall with graffiti sprayed across it.” Fear: “a long dark corridor with no visible end.”
blocks.zh: 愤怒:“一堵被涂上涂有涂鸦的新墙”。 恐惧:“漫长的黑暗走廊,没有明显的终点。 “

blocks.en: Sadness is represented through loss, abandonment, deterioration, and isolation. Amusement draws on playful incongruity and light-hearted interaction, while excitement is associated with anticipation, speed, crowds, performance, and visually dynamic events.
blocks.zh: 悲伤表现为损失、被抛弃、恶化和孤立。 娱乐利用了玩弄的不和谐和轻心互动,而兴奋则与预期、速度、人群、表现和视觉动态事件有关。

blocks.en: The evoked-emotion pool contains 50 50 prompts for each of the eight categories and 400 400 prompts in total.
blocks.zh: 唤起的情绪池中包含8个类别中每个类别的50个提示和400 400个提示。

blocks.en: A.2 T2I Models and Image Generation
blocks.zh: A.2 T2I 模型和图像生成

blocks.en: We select eight T2I models spanning open-source checkpoints and proprietary APIs, several generations of diffusion and rectified-flow systems, and architectures with different efficiency targets. The selection includes established models and more recent systems with distinct architectural and access characteristics. Each model receives the same 800 800 semantic prompts and generates one image per prompt, producing 800 800 images per model and 6400 6400 images overall. Open-source models are run with their released checkpoints and native inference pipelines, and proprietary models are accessed through APIs. No candidate reranking or post-generation filtering is performed using emotion labels or aesthetic scores.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了8个T2I模型,它们跨越开放源码检查站和专有的API,几代传播和纠正流系统,以及具有不同效率目标的架构. 选择包括既有模式和具有独特建筑和准入特征的更近期系统。 每个模型都得到同样的800800个语义提示,并且每个提示产生一幅图像,每个模型产生800800个图像,总体64006400个图像. 开源模型与其已放行的检查站和本土推导管运行,通过API访问专有模型. 不使用情感标签或美学分数进行考生再排位或生成后过滤.

blocks.en: PixArt- Σ \Sigma ( Chen et al., 2024 ) is a diffusion-transformer model developed for efficient high-resolution text-to-image synthesis. It adopts a weak-to-strong training strategy that transfers knowledge from lower-resolution and lower-cost training stages to more demanding generation settings. The model supports multi-scale image synthesis and extends the PixArt family towards direct 4 4 K generation. Its design emphasizes reduced training cost while maintaining prompt adherence and fine visual detail.
blocks.zh: PixArt- \Sigma(Chen等,2024年-)是一款为高效高分辨率文本到图像合成而开发的传播-转换模型. 它采用一种弱到强的培训战略,将知识从低分辨率和低成本的培训阶段转移到更严格的一代人环境。 该模型支持多尺度图像合成,并扩展了PixArt家族到直通4 4 K代. 其设计强调降低培训费用,同时保持迅速坚持和精细的视觉细节.

blocks.en: Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) introduces the Multimodal Diffusion Transformer architecture and trains it with rectified flow. Text and image representations retain modality-specific parameters while interacting through joint attention, enabling close alignment between linguistic instructions and generated content. The model combines multiple text encoders to capture token-level detail and broader prompt semantics. These components target improved typography, spatial composition, prompt adherence, and visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 稳定扩散 3(Esser等,2024年)引入了多式扩散变形器架构并用正流来训练. 文本和图像表示保留了特定模式的参数,同时通过联合关注进行互动,使语言指令和生成的内容能够紧密相通. 该模型结合了多个文本编码器,以捕捉符号级的细节和更广泛的即时语义. 这些组成部分的目标是改进打字、空间组成、迅速遵守和视觉忠诚。

blocks.en: Stable Diffusion 3.5 ( Stability AI, 2024 ) extends the Stable Diffusion 3 family through revised training and model configurations. It retains the multimodal diffusion-transformer formulation while improving prompt adherence, image quality, and stylistic diversity. The family provides models with different capacity and efficiency profiles, including a high-capacity Large variant. Its training places particular emphasis on varied visual styles and more reliable rendering of complex prompts.
blocks.zh: Stable Divusion 3.5 (Stable AI, 2024 )通过修改培训和模型配置来扩展Stable Divusion 3家族. 它保留了多式传播-转换式配方,同时改进了迅速遵守、图像质量和形式多样性。 家庭提供具有不同能力和效率特征的模型,包括大容量变体. 其培训特别强调各种视觉风格和复杂提示的更可靠的渲染。

blocks.en: FLUX.2 ( Labs, 2025 ) belongs to the FLUX family of rectified-flow image generators. It is designed for detailed visual synthesis, instruction following, and high-resolution output across varied subjects and styles. The FLUX.2-klein- 9 9 B variant emphasizes efficient inference and can generate images with a small number of sampling steps. This efficiency-oriented design distinguishes it from models that rely on longer iterative denoising schedules.
blocks.zh: FLUX.2 (Labs, 2025)属于纠正流图像生成器的FLUX家族. 它旨在进行详细的视觉合成,遵循指示,以及不同主题和风格的高分辨率输出. FLUX.2-克林-9 9 B变体强调高效推论,能用少量的采样步骤来生成图像. 这种以效率为导向的设计将它与依赖更长时间的迭代去名调度的模型区分开来.

blocks.en: Z-Image ( Cai et al., 2025 ) is an image-generation foundation model based on a single-stream diffusion transformer. Text conditions and noisy visual representations are processed within a unified sequence, allowing cross-modal interaction throughout generation. The model is designed to combine efficient inference with semantic alignment and detailed synthesis. Its architecture provides a compact alternative to diffusion transformers that maintain separate processing streams for different modalities.
blocks.zh: Z-Image(Cai等,2025年)是一款基于单流扩散变压器的图像生成基模型. 文本条件和吵闹的视觉表现方式在一个统一的序列中处理,允许跨模式交互整个世代. 该模型旨在将高效推论与语义对接和详细合成相结合. 它的架构提供了一种紧凑的可替代扩散变压器的方法,这种变压器为不同方式维持单独的处理流.

blocks.en: Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025 ) is a text-to-image foundation model developed for general image synthesis and precise visual control. It combines a multimodal diffusion-transformer architecture with representations derived from the Qwen vision-language family. The model places particular emphasis on rendering complex text, preserving fine-grained semantics, and following detailed natural-language instructions. It also supports a unified range of generation and image-editing tasks.
blocks.zh: Quen-Image (Wu等,2025年)是一款为一般图像合成和精确视觉控制而开发的文字到图像基础模型. 它结合了由Quen视觉-语言家族衍生的多式传播-转换结构. 该模型特别强调渲染复杂的文字,保留精细的纹理语义,并遵循详细的自然语言指令. 它还支持统一范围的生成和图像编辑任务.

blocks.en: Seedream 5.0 ( ByteDance Seed Team, 2026 ) is a proprietary image-generation model developed for high-fidelity synthesis and detailed instruction following. It supports photographic, artistic, and design-oriented content while preserving fine visual details under complex prompts. The model also provides image-editing capabilities within the same generation system. Its internal architecture and training configuration are not publicly exposed.
blocks.zh: 种子梦 5.0 (ByteDance Seed Team, 2026年-)是一款专有的图像生成模型,为高真性合成和后续详细指令所开发. 它支持以摄影、艺术和设计为导向的内容,同时在复杂的提示下保留精细的视觉细节。 该模型还提供同代系统中的图像编辑能力. 其内部架构和培训配置并未被公开曝光.

blocks.en: GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) is a proprietary model integrated into OpenAI’s multimodal image-generation system. It is designed to follow detailed natural-language instructions and preserve relationships among objects, attributes, and spatial constraints. The model supports image synthesis and editing, with particular attention to text rendering and iterative refinement. Its internal architecture, training data, and sampling procedure are not publicly disclosed.
blocks.zh: GPT-Image-2(OpenAI,2026b)是集成于OpenAI多模式图像生成系统的专有模式. 它旨在遵循详细的自然语言指令并维护物体、属性和空间限制之间的关系。 该模型支持图像合成和编辑,并特别关注文本渲染和迭代完善. 其内部结构、培训数据和取样程序不公开披露。

blocks.en: A.3 Visual-Quality Variation
blocks.zh: A.3 视觉质量变化

blocks.en: EmoGenie retains one generated output for every prompt–model combination without filtering by aesthetic quality. This preserves the quality variation produced under the benchmark generation settings and prevents post-generation selection from altering the empirical model distributions.
blocks.zh: EmoGenie为每个即时-模型组合保留一个生成的输出,而不通过美学质量进行过滤. 这保留了在基准生成设置下产生的质量差异,并阻止了后生成选择改变经验模型分布.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Distribution of aesthetic quality across T2I models for (a) expressed-emotion and (b) evoked-emotion images. Each violin summarizes the human-aggregated ratings of 400 400 images from one model. Internal boxes indicate the interquartile range, white lines denote the median, and red points denote the mean. All ratings use the original 1 1 – 5 5 scale.
blocks.zh: 图4:T2I模型中美学质量的分布情况,用于(a)表达-情感和(b)激发-情感图像。 每把小提琴从一个模型中总结出400400个图像的人类综合收视率. 内部框表示相位范围,白线表示中位数,而红点表示中位数. 所有收视率都使用原作"一一"(11–5 5 scale).

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the image-level distributions of human-aggregated aesthetic ratings for the 400 400 expressed-emotion and 400 400 evoked-emotion images generated by each model. The expressed-emotion distributions differ substantially across models. GPT-Image-2 attains the highest mean rating ( 3.88 3.88 ), followed by Qwen-Image ( 3.49 3.49 ) and Seedream 5.0 ( 3.46 3.46 ), whereas PixArt- Σ \Sigma has a markedly lower centre ( 2.02 2.02 ). SD3 and SD3.5 also exhibit broad distributions with pronounced lower-quality tails. By contrast, Qwen-Image, Seedream 5.0, FLUX.2, and Z-Image concentrate more of their probability mass above the midpoint of the scale. These distributional differences complement the aggregate results in the main text by showing that the performance gap is not driven by a small number of isolated outputs.
blocks.zh: 图4显示每个模型产生的400 400个表达情感和400 400个激发情感图像的图像水平分布。 不同模型的表达-情绪分布差别很大。 GPT-Image-2获得最高中分(3.88 3.88分),其次是Quen-Image (3.49 3.49分)和Seedream 5.0 (3.46 3.46分),而PixArt-Σ\Sigma有一个明显较低的中心(2.02.02分). SD3和SD3.5也呈现出有显著出质量较低的尾巴的广泛分布. 相形之下,Quen-Image,Seedream 5.0,FLUX.2和Z-Image将其概率质量更集中在比分中点以上. 这些分配差异补充了正文中的总结果,表明业绩差距并非由少数孤立产出所驱动。

blocks.en: The evoked-emotion distributions are more tightly clustered. Their model means range from 3.42 3.42 to 3.71 3.71 , compared with 2.02 2.02 to 3.88 3.88 for expressed emotion, and the interquartile ranges overlap extensively. GPT-Image-2 remains the strongest model on average, but its separation from the remaining models is smaller than in the expressed-emotion setting. Seven models receive higher mean ratings for evoked-emotion images; GPT-Image-2 is the only model with a higher mean for expressed emotion. The largest perspective shifts occur for PixArt- Σ \Sigma , SD3.5, and SD3. This pattern is consistent with the additional rendering constraints imposed by expressed-emotion prompts, for which facial structure, bodily coherence, and category-specific expression cues must be jointly preserved. Evoked-emotion prompts can distribute affective evidence across scene content, lighting, colour, and composition, yielding more homogeneous visual-quality distributions across generators.
blocks.zh: 被激发的情绪分布更紧密地组合在一起. 他们的型号表示在3.42 3.42到3.71 3.71之间,而表现的情感则表示在2.02 2.02到3.88 3.88之间,而相位相位相去甚远. GPT-Image-2仍然是平均来说最强的模型,但是它与所剩模型的分离比在表示-情感设定中要小. 7个模型对被激发的情感图像获得较高的平均收视率;GPT-Image-2是唯一一个对表达情感具有较高平均值的模型. 最大的视角变化发生在PixArt - \\Sigma,SD3.5,和SD3. 这种模式与表达-情感提示所施加的额外渲染限制是一致的,为此面部结构,身体上的一致性,以及特定类别的表达提示必须共同保存. Evoked-Emotion 提示可以将情感证据分布到场景内容,照明,色彩和组成,产生更同质的视觉质量分布在发电机上.

blocks.en: Appendix B Details of Human Annotation and Benchmark Assembly
blocks.zh: 附录B 人类注释和基准大会的细节

blocks.en: B.1 Annotation Dimensions and Interface
blocks.zh: B.1 注释尺寸和接口

blocks.en: Annotation is conducted in two rounds. Before each round, annotators receive written definitions, scale anchors, and worked examples that distinguish the emotion expressed by a depicted person from the emotion evoked in a viewer. Images are presented in randomized order, and all fields applicable to the assigned affective perspective must be completed before submission.
blocks.zh: 注释分两轮进行. 在每一回合之前,注释者会收到书面定义,比例主播,以及工作实例,区分被描绘出的人所表现的情感和被观众所激发的情感. 图像按随机排列的顺序呈现,所有适用于所指定活性视角的字段必须在提交前完成.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Structured annotation interfaces. (a) Expressed-emotion annotation records the emotion conveyed by the depicted person, its expression intensity, and aesthetic quality. (b) Evoked-emotion annotation records the emotion elicited in the viewer, valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality. The displayed selections illustrate the interface layout.
blocks.zh: 图5:结构化注释界面. (a) 表达式情感注释记录被描绘的人所传达的情感、其表达强度和美学质量。 (b) Evoked-Emotion注解记录了在观众中产生的情绪、价值、刺激、支配地位和美学质量。 显示的选中范围说明了界面布局 。

blocks.en: The first round collects structured perceptual judgments for all 6400 6400 images (Fig. 5 ). Each image receives 15 15 independent annotations, yielding 96 96 K image-level records and 384 384 K dimension-level judgments. The interface presents each image alongside the response fields defined for its affective perspective.
blocks.zh: 第一轮收集了所有6400 6400图像的结构化概念判断(图5). 每个图像都收到15个15个独立说明,产生96个96K图像级记录和384个384K维度级判断. 界面将每个图像与针对其情感视角所定义的响应字段相并列。

blocks.en: For expressed-emotion images, annotators select the emotion conveyed by the subject’s visible expression from anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and neutral. They then rate expression intensity as mild, moderate, or intense according to the magnitude and coordination of facial and bodily cues. Aesthetic quality is rated on a 1 1 – 5 5 scale based on composition, colour, illumination, clarity, realism, and overall visual impact. Annotators are instructed to assess the emotion displayed by the depicted person rather than their own response to the image.
blocks.zh: 对于表达情感的图像,注释者从愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、幸福、悲哀、出人意料和中立的角度来选择被主体明显表达的情感。 然后,根据面部和身体提示的大小和协调程度,将表达强度评为温和、中和或剧烈。 美学质量根据成分,颜色,发光,清晰,现实,整体视觉效果,按11–5级评分. 注释者被指示评估被描绘的人所表现的情感,而不是自己对图像的反应.

blocks.en: For evoked-emotion images, annotators select the emotion primarily elicited in them from amusement, anger, awe, contentment, disgust, excitement, fear, and sadness. They also rate valence, arousal, and dominance using the 9 9 -point Self-Assessment Manikin scale ( Bradley & Lang, 1994 ) , which measures the pleasantness, activation, and perceived control associated with the elicited response. Aesthetic quality is assessed on the same 1 1 – 5 5 scale. The instructions direct annotators to consider the complete scene, including its content, composition, lighting, colour, and atmosphere.
blocks.zh: 对于被唤起的情感影像, 注释者从其中主要引出的感觉 从娱乐,愤怒,敬畏,满足,厌恶,兴奋,恐惧,和悲伤。 他们还使用9分自评马尼金比例(Bradley & Lang,1994年)来评分高低、振奋和主导地位,该比例衡量与被引出的反应有关的舒适性、活性和感知控制。 美学质量评定为同分一等分一等分一等分五等分. 指示指示注释者考虑整个场景,包括其内容,组成,照明,颜色和大气.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Evidence-grounded description interfaces. (a) Expressed-emotion annotation elicits visual evidence for the category and intensity judgments and records contextual or additional emotional cues. (b) Evoked-emotion annotation characterizes scene-level evidence, elicits rationales for the VAD ratings, and records mixed emotional responses. (c) An expressed-emotion image pair requires a comparison of the facial and bodily evidence underlying an intensity difference. (d) An evoked-emotion image pair requires the visual factors underlying a difference in continuous affective ratings to be identified.
blocks.zh: 图6:证据说明接口。 (a) 表达式情绪注释为类别和强度判断提供视觉证据,并记录背景或额外的情绪提示。 (b) Evoked-Emotion注解是场景一级证据的特征,引出VAD评级的理由,并记录了混合的情感反应. (c) 表情-情绪相配的图像需要比较强度差异背后的面部和身体证据。 (d) 触发-情绪图像对应需要识别持续情感评级差异的视觉因素。

blocks.en: The second round elicits evidence-grounded descriptions for a stratified subset of 500 500 images, comprising 300 300 single-image cases and 100 100 image pairs (Fig. 6 ). Four annotators complete this round. For expressed emotion, the interface provides the aggregated category and intensity and asks annotators to identify supporting or inconsistent facial and bodily cues, explain the assigned intensity, describe contextual influences, and note additional emotional cues. For evoked emotion, annotators characterize the scene, colour, and lighting; identify the visual elements associated with the elicited emotion; justify the VAD ratings; and record additional or mixed responses. Pairwise cases display both images side by side and ask annotators to describe the visual differences underlying the comparative judgment. The resulting descriptions are edited into the questions and reference answers for the open-ended task.
blocks.zh: 第二轮对由500个图像组成的分层子集进行了有证据依据的描述,包括300个300个单相图像和100个100个图像对(图6)。 四名注释员完成了这一轮. 对于表达的情感,界面提供了汇总的分类和强度,并要求注释者识别支持或不一致的面部和身体提示,解释指定强度,描述上下文的影响,并注意额外的情感提示. 对于被激起的情感,注释者描述场景、颜色和照明;识别与被激起的情感相关的视觉要素;为VAD的收视率辩护;并记录额外或混合的反应。 平面大小写同时显示两种图像,并要求注释者描述比较判断背后的视觉差异. 由此产生的说明被编辑成不限成员名额任务的问题和参考答案。

blocks.en: B.2 Aggregation and agreement analysis
blocks.zh: B.2 汇总和协议分析

blocks.en: We verify record completeness, image identity, label validity, and rating ranges before aggregation. Emotion categories are aggregated by majority vote, with all tied leading categories retained; tied cases are excluded only from benchmark questions requiring a unique reference answer. Expression intensity, VAD, and aesthetic quality are averaged on their original scales.
blocks.zh: 我们在汇总前核查记录完整性、图像身份、标签有效性和评级范围。 情感类别通过多数表决汇总,所有捆绑的主要类别保留;捆绑的案例仅被排除于需要独特的参考答案的基准问题. 表达强度,VAD,和美学质量按其原始尺度平均.

This treatment preserves the ordering of expression intensity ( 1 1 – 3 3 ), VAD ( 1 1 – 9 9 ), and aesthetic quality ( 1 1 – 5 5 ) without treating adjacent and maximally separated disagreements as equivalent.

blocks.en: B.3 Detailed Construction of EmoGenie-QA
blocks.zh: B.3 EmoGenie-QA详细建筑

blocks.en: EmoGenie-QA comprises closed-set perception questions and open-ended description questions derived from the aggregated annotations. The perception task comprises single-image questions in multiple-choice and yes-or-no formats, as well as image-pair questions that require a comparison between two images. Both settings cover the applicable dimensions of emotion category, expression intensity, VAD, and aesthetic quality. This portion contains 90,000 90{,}000 questions, including 40,000 40{,}000 single-image and 50,000 50{,}000 image-pair questions. We use an image-disjoint, stratified split of 72,000 72{,}000 questions for training and 18,000 18{,}000 for testing; the test set contains 8,000 8{,}000 single-image and 10,000 10{,}000 image-pair questions. Images occurring in the same pair are assigned jointly to prevent visual overlap between the two splits.
blocks.zh: EmoGenie-QA由封闭式感知问题和从综合说明中得出的开放式描述问题组成。 感想任务包括多选择和"是"或"否"格式的单相图像问题,以及需要将两个相像进行比较的相像问题. 这两种设置都涵盖了情感类别,表达强度,VAD,和美学质量的可适用维度. 这一部分包含90,000个问题,包括40,000个40{,}000个单相像和50,000个50{,}000个图像-pair问题. 我们用图象分解,分出72,000个72{,}000个问题进行训练,18,000个18{,}000个问题进行测试;测试集包含8,000个8{,}000个单一图像和10,000个10{,}000个图像pair问题。 在同一对中发生的相片被联合指定,以防止两个相片之间的视觉重叠.

blocks.en: The description task requires an emotion judgment supported by visible evidence. Single-image questions elicit explanations based on facial, bodily, or scene-level cues, whereas image-pair questions require both a comparative judgment and an account of the salient visual differences. The final set contains 1,057 1{,}057 evaluation-only questions, comprising 957 957 single-image and 100 100 image-pair questions.
blocks.zh: 描述任务需要情感判断,有明显证据支持. 单一图像问题需要根据面部、身体或场景层面的提示作出解释,而图像-图像问题则需要比较判断和说明明显的视觉差异。 最终集包含1,057 1{,}057个只评价问题,由957个957个单相相和100个图像平面问题组成.

blocks.en: B.4 Detailed Construction of EmoGenie-Assess
blocks.zh: B.4. EmoGenie-Assess的详细建筑

blocks.en: EmoGenie-Assess contains continuous affective and aesthetic scores aggregated from the human ratings. Valence, arousal, and dominance are provided for evoked-emotion images on their original 1 1 – 9 9 scales, while aesthetic quality is provided for both affective perspectives on a 1 1 – 5 5 scale. Each score is the mean rating for one image and dimension.
blocks.zh: EmoGenie-Assess包含从人类收视率中汇总的连续有影响和审美分. 在最初的1 1 至 9 9 个比例尺上为激发-情感图像提供了威严、振奋和主导地位,同时在1 1 至 5 个比例尺上为两个情感视角提供了美学质量。 每个分数都是一个图像和维度的平均分.

blocks.en: The subset contains 13,175 13{,}175 scores, comprising 2,590 2{,}590 valence, 2,475 2{,}475 arousal, 2,400 2{,}400 dominance, and 5,710 5{,}710 aesthetic-quality scores. Using the same image-disjoint partitioning principle as EmoGenie-QA, we allocate 10,540 10{,}540 scores to the training side, of which 535 535 form the validation set, and reserve 2,635 2{,}635 for testing. The test portion contains 518 518 valence, 495 495 arousal, 480 480 dominance, and 1,142 1{,}142 aesthetic-quality scores.
blocks.zh: 子集包含有13,175个13{,}175个分数,包括2,590个2{,}590个等分数,2,475个2{,}475个催生分数,2,400个2{,}400个主导分数,以及5,710个5{,}710个审美质量分数. 使用与EmoGenie-QA相同的图像-分解分出原理,我们为训练方分配了10,540分(10{,}540分),其中535,535分构成验证集,并保留了2,635分2{,}635分用于测试. 测试部分包含有518个518个valence,495个aruntal,480个480个主导,以及1,142 1{,}142个审美质量分数.

blocks.en: D.1 Detailed Information of Compared MLLMs
blocks.zh: D.1 比较 MLLM的详细资料

blocks.en: The compared MLLMs encompass general-purpose open-source systems, proprietary systems, and architectures developed specifically for emotion understanding. Collectively, these models cover both general multimodal understanding and emotion-specific modelling, ranging from unified vision-language architectures to specialized mechanisms for affective perception and confidence calibration.
blocks.zh: 比较的MLLMS包括通用开源系统,专有系统,以及专门为情感理解而开发的架构. 这些模型共同涵盖一般的多模式理解和情感特异性建模,从统一的视觉语言架构到感知和信心校正的专门机制.

blocks.en: Janus-Pro-7B ( Chen et al., 2025 ) is a unified multimodal model for visual understanding and image generation. It employs separate visual encoders for the two tasks, allowing each pathway to learn task-specific representations. Both pathways connect to a shared autoregressive language backbone for multimodal reasoning and synthesis. This decoupled visual design separates the representational requirements of perception from those of generation.
blocks.zh: Janus-Pro-7B (Chen等,2025年)是视觉理解和图像生成的统一多模式. 它为这两项任务使用单独的可视编码器,使每个路径都能学习特定任务的表现. 这两个途径都连接到一个共享的自旋语言主干线,用于多模式推理和合成. 这种脱钩的外观设计将感知的表达要求同代相分离.

blocks.en: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-8B-Instruct ( An et al., 2025 ) is an open vision-language model developed within the LLaVA-OneVision framework. It connects an upgraded visual encoder to a language model through a multimodal projector. Its staged training progressively incorporates single-image, multi-image, and video data. These input types are processed within a unified instruction-following interface.
blocks.zh: LLaVA-One Vision-1.5-8B-Instruct(An等,2025年)是在LLaVA-One Vision框架内开发的开放式视觉语言模型. 它通过多式投影仪将一个升级的视觉编码器与语言模型相接. 其分阶段培训逐步纳入了单相图、多相图和视频数据。 这些输入类型在一个统一的跟随指令的界面内处理.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025b ) is a general-purpose MLLM for image, document, and video understanding. Its dynamic-resolution mechanism represents visual inputs with a variable number of tokens according to their spatial dimensions. This design preserves fine-grained visual content while adapting computation to the input. Spatial and temporal representations further support visual grounding and video comprehension.
blocks.zh: Qun2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (Bai等,2025b.)是用于图像,文档和视频理解的通用MLLM. 其活性分辨率机制代表了视相输入,视其空间维度而定,有可变个数的指相. 这种设计在使计算适应输入的同时保留了精细的视觉内容. 空间和时间表现进一步支持视觉地面定位和视频理解。

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025a ) is an instruction-tuned vision-language model for fine-grained visual grounding and multimodal reasoning. It accepts both single-image and multi-image inputs. Its instruction tuning covers visual recognition, localization, relational understanding, and reasoning over visual evidence. The language backbone produces structured natural-language responses conditioned on the multimodal context.
blocks.zh: Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct (Bai等,2025a.)是一款用于精致视觉地基和多模式推理的教学调取视觉语言模型. 它接受单相和多相的输入. 它的指令调制包括视觉识别,本地化,关系理解,以及视觉证据的推理. 语言主干部分以多式联运为条件,产生结构化的自然语言响应。

blocks.en: Qwen3.5-VL-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) is a general-purpose model from the Qwen multimodal family. It integrates visual representations with the language and reasoning capabilities of the Qwen3.5 foundation model. The model supports instruction following, multi-image understanding, and visually grounded reasoning. These capabilities are provided through a unified multimodal conversational interface.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5-VL-9B(Quen Team,2026年-)是出自于Quen多模式家族的通用型号. 它将视觉表现与Quen3.5基础模型的语言和推理能力相融合. 该模型支持以下指示、多图像理解和视基推理。 这些能力是通过统一的多模式对话界面提供的。

blocks.en: InternVL3-8B-Instruct ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) is an instruction-tuned MLLM from the InternVL family. It connects a high-capacity vision encoder to a language model through a learned multimodal interface. Native multimodal training aligns visual and linguistic representations before instruction tuning. The model supports single-image, multi-image, and video understanding within a shared architecture.
blocks.zh: InternVL3-8B-Instruct (Zhu等,2025年)是一款由InternVL家族提供的指导调取的MLLM. 它通过学习到的多模式界面将高容量的视觉编码器与语言模型相接. 本土多模式培训在调整教学之前,将视觉和语言表述相协调。 该模型支持在共享架构内实现单相相,多相相和视频理解.

blocks.en: InternVL3.5-8B-Instruct ( Wang et al., 2025 ) is an open-source MLLM trained through native multimodal pre-training followed by instruction tuning. It extends the InternVL architecture with enhanced visual representation learning, multimodal alignment, and reasoning-oriented optimization. The model accepts single-image, multi-image, and video inputs. These modalities are handled through a common conversational interface for visually grounded instruction following.
blocks.zh: InternVL3.5-8B-Instructionct(Wang等,2025年)是一种开源的MLLM,通过本土多模式预训培训,后再进行教学调试. 它扩展了InternVL架构,强化了视觉表现学习,多模式对接,并进行了以推理为导向的优化. 该模型接受单相相,多相相相,并接受视频输入. 这些模式通过一个共同的对讲界面处理。

blocks.en: GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) is a proprietary general-purpose multimodal model accessed through an official interface. It accepts visual and textual inputs and generates instruction-conditioned natural-language responses. Its capabilities encompass broad visual understanding and multimodal reasoning rather than a dedicated emotion-processing architecture. Detailed information about its training data, internal architecture, and model parameters is not publicly available.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.5 (OpenAI, 2026a.)是通过官方界面访问的专有通用多式车型. 它接受视觉和文字投入,并生成具有教学条件的自然语言响应. 其能力包括广泛的视觉理解和多模式推理,而不是专门的情感处理架构. 关于其培训数据、内部架构和模型参数的详细信息不公开。

blocks.en: Claude-Sonnet-4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) is a proprietary multimodal model for visual understanding, instruction following, and reasoning. It processes images jointly with textual context to produce natural-language judgments and explanations. The model supports visually grounded analysis across general application domains. Its training data, architectural details, and model parameters are not publicly disclosed.
blocks.zh: Claude-Sonnet 4.6 (Anthropic, 2026)是视觉理解,指令跟随,推理的专有多式模型. 它结合文字背景处理图像,产生自然语言判断和解释. 该模型支持在一般应用领域进行视网膜分析。 其培训数据,建筑细节和模型参数不公开披露.

blocks.en: Emotion-Qwen ( Huang et al., 2025 ) is an emotion-oriented MLLM that combines fine-grained affective understanding with general vision-language reasoning. Its mixture-of-experts Hybrid Compressor balances general visual information and emotion-specific features through a learned gating network. A Facial Emotion Capture module emphasizes facial cues associated with affective states. Progressive training with emotion-oriented data and multiple LoRA branches limits interference between specialized and general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 情感-Quen(Huang等,2025年)是一种以情感为取向的MLLM,将精致的感性理解和一般视觉语言推理相结合. 其混合型专家混合压缩机通过有知识的取景网络来平衡一般视觉信息和情感特异性. 一个面部情感捕捉模块强调与情感状态相关的面部提示. 以以情感为导向的数据进行渐进式训练以及多个LORA分支限制专门能力和一般能力的干扰.

blocks.en: EmoCaliber ( Wu et al., 2026 ) is an emotion-oriented MLLM that explicitly verbalizes and calibrates predictive confidence. Built on Qwen2.5-VL, it first acquires structured emotion reasoning through supervised fine-tuning. Semantic and probabilistic priors are subsequently introduced to support confidence estimation. A reinforcement-learning stage jointly optimizes emotion prediction and confidence calibration.
blocks.zh: EmoCaliber(Wu等,2026年)是一种以情感为取向的MLLM,它明确用口语来表达并校正预测性自信. 它建于Quen2.5-VL上,首先通过有监督的微调获得结构化的情感推理. 随后引入了语义学和概率学前科以支持信心估计. 强化-学习阶段联合优化了情感预测和信心校正.

blocks.en: EEmo-Logic ( Gao et al., 2026b ) is an MLLM developed for image-evoked emotion understanding. Its first stage applies emotion instruction tuning to establish categorical perception and affective reasoning. The second stage employs task-specific reinforcement learning for emotion ranking, VAD prediction, and dominant-emotion classification. The same training framework supports evidence-grounded explanations of evoked emotional responses.
blocks.zh: EEmo-Logic (Gao et al., 2026b.)是一款为图像感知情感而开发的MLLM. 它的第一阶段应用了情感指示调和,以建立绝对感知和情感推理. 第二阶段采用特定任务强化学习来进行情感排位,VAD预测和主情绪分级. 同一培训框架支持以证据为依据解释对情绪的反应。

blocks.en: EmoVIT ( Xie et al., 2024 ) adapts the InstructBLIP architecture to visual emotion understanding through instruction tuning. Its training corpus contains categorical, conversational, and reasoning instructions for affective image analysis. The instruction-aware Q-Former is optimized to connect visual features with the language model. The visual encoder and language model remain frozen, concentrating adaptation in the Q-Former.
blocks.zh: EmoVIT (Xie等,2024)通过指令调取来使InstructBLIP架构适应视觉情感理解. 它的训练大纲中包含直截了当的,对话的,以及情感图像分析的推理指示. 指令-意识Q-Former被优化,可以将视觉特征与语言模型相接. 视觉编码器和语言模型仍然被冻结,将适应集中在Q-Former.

blocks.en: AffectGPT ( Lian et al., 2025 ) is an emotion-oriented MLLM for affective understanding from audio, video, and text. It introduces multimodal pre-fusion modules that integrate modality-specific evidence before language-model processing. Its fusion mechanisms preserve temporal information and emphasize informative features across modalities. Training on MER-Caption supports natural-language emotion descriptions grounded in multimodal evidence.
blocks.zh: AffectGPT(Lian等,2025年)是一种以情感为取向的MLLM,用于从音频,视频和文本中进行情感理解. 它引入了在语言-模型处理前整合特定模式证据的多模式预装模块. 其聚变机制保存了时间信息,强调各种模式的信息特征。 关于MER-Caption的培训支持基于多模式证据的自然语言情感描述。

blocks.en: D.2 Extended Evaluation of T2I Emotion Generation
blocks.zh: D.2 对T2I情感生成的扩展评价

blocks.en: Figure 7: Category-level confusion matrices for the emotion-generation capability of eight T2I models. Rows denote generation prompts and columns denote emotions assigned by human annotators. For expressed emotion, A–G correspond to anger, disgust, fear, happiness, neutral, sadness, and surprise. For evoked emotion, A–H correspond to amusement, anger, awe, contentment, disgust, excitement, fear, and sadness. Each row is normalized to sum to 1 1 ; diagonal entries indicate target-emotion alignment, and off-diagonal entries show the distribution of emotion substitutions.

blocks.en: The main paper reports category-level target-emotion alignment, whereas Fig. 7 resolves the human annotations into normalized confusion matrices for each generator. Rows denote the emotions specified by the generation prompts, and columns denote the emotions assigned by annotators. Diagonal concentration therefore indicates reliable target-emotion generation, while off-diagonal mass identifies systematic substitutions between categories.
blocks.zh: 主要论文报告类别级目标-情绪相接,而图7则将人类说明解为每个生成器的常态混淆矩阵. 行表示由一代提示指定的情绪,列表示由注释者指定的情绪. 因此,对角浓度表示可靠的目标-情绪生成,而非对角质量则表示类别之间的系统替代。

blocks.en: For expressed emotion, happiness and surprise form the most consistent diagonals across models, whereas the principal errors occur among negative categories with partially shared facial and bodily cues. Anger is frequently annotated as disgust, and fear is often annotated as surprise. GPT-Image-2 separates these categories most clearly, while several other models retain strong alignment for happiness, sadness, and surprise but show concentrated failure on fear or disgust. SD3 exhibits a broader shift towards neutral, suggesting that some generated expressions lack sufficiently distinctive or intense cues.
blocks.zh: 对于表达的情感,幸福和惊喜组成了各模型之间最一致的对角,而主要错误发生在部分分享面部和身体提示的负面类别中. 愤怒常常被说成令人厌恶,而恐惧往往被说成令人惊讶。 GPT-Image-2将这些类别区分得最清楚,而其他几个模式则保留了对幸福,悲伤和出人意料的强烈配合,但显示集中的失败在于恐惧或厌恶. SD3表现出向中性的更广义的转变,说明一些产生的表达缺乏足够有特色或强烈的提示.

blocks.en: The evoked-emotion matrices show a different structure. Contentment is generated consistently across models, with awe and excitement also displaying comparatively stable diagonals. Amusement is often interpreted as contentment, indicating that positive scenes may convey pleasantness without the more specific contextual cues associated with amusement. Anger is the least stable category and is frequently reassigned to disgust. The distribution of fear and sadness further differentiates the generators, with stronger models maintaining clearer category boundaries and weaker models shifting these prompts towards awe or contentment.
blocks.zh: 被激发的情绪矩阵显示了不同的结构. 内容在各种模型中不断产生,敬畏和兴奋也表现出相对稳定的对角. 乐趣往往被解释为满足,表明正面的场景可能传达出愉快,而没有与娱乐相关的更具体的背景提示. 愤怒是最不稳定的类别,经常被重新分配给令人作呕。 恐惧和悲伤的分布进一步区分了产生者,更强大的模型保持更清晰的类别界限,更弱的模型将这些诱因转向敬畏或满足.

blocks.en: Overall, expressed-emotion errors cluster among categories with similar facial or bodily manifestations, particularly anger and disgust or fear and surprise. Evoked-emotion errors more often connect states with related valence or scene-level semantics, such as amusement and contentment. These perspective-specific substitutions reveal category-level weaknesses that are obscured by aggregate alignment scores, highlighting the importance of evaluating each affective perspective at the level of individual emotion categories.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,表情-情感错误在面部或身体表现相似的类别中分组,特别是愤怒和厌恶或恐惧和出其不意。 Evoked-emotion 错误更经常地将状态与相关的valence或场景层次的语义相连接,如游乐和满足. 这些视角特异性的取而代之揭示出类别层面的弱点被总体对齐分数所掩盖,凸显出在个人情感类别层面评价每个情感视角的重要性.

blocks.zh: D.3 不限成员名额说明的评价标准

blocks.en: With reference to the evaluation protocol of EEmo-Logic ( Gao et al., 2026b ) , we assess open-ended responses along four dimensions: correctness , completeness , relevance , and conciseness , each scored from 0 0 to 2 2 . DeepSeek-Flash evaluates the first three dimensions using the question, candidate response, human reference answer, and scoring rubric, without access to the image or model identity. Conciseness is computed deterministically from the candidate-to-reference word-count ratio.
blocks.zh: 关于EEmo-Logic(Gao等,2026年b)的评价协议,我们按四个方面评估不限成员名额的反应:正确性、完整性、相关性和简洁性,每个方面得分从0分到2分。 DeepSeek-Flash使用问题,候选反应,人文参考答案,和分数等分号来评价前三个维度,没有获得图像或模型身份. 简明性是根据候选人与参考字数比率确定的。

blocks.en: The expressed-emotion results followed the same pattern: EmoProbe led 5 of 6 comparisons. blocks.en: We provide additional qualitative results that complement the aggregate evaluation in the main paper. Fig. 8 compares continuous predictions with human-aggregated scores for valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality, whereas Figs. 9 and 10 present challenging closed-set questions spanning single-image judgments and image-pair comparisons. In the illustrated cases, EmoProbe closely follows the human scores and correctly resolves questions for which most comparison models produce incorrect responses. Together, these examples show how the model supports both fine-grained continuous assessment and categorical emotion perception across the expressed- and evoked-emotion perspectives.
